# God of War 3 Remastered PC Wiki

> Fan wiki for the unofficial God of War 3 Remastered PC port — install guides, 4K/240FPS performance settings, FSR, mods and cheats, and how it compares to RPCS3 emulation.

Site: https://godofwar3remastered.wiki
